tasks.summary: Parse three banks' messy statement exports into one normalized format
tasks.hard_because: Real-world CSV mess documented in FORMATS.md: BOM, CRLF, ';' and ',' delimiters, decimal comma, thousands separators (including no-break space), trailing-minus and parenthesized negatives, three date formats, quoted descriptions with newlines, footer lines. Hidden files combine these.

tasks.summary: Bug report whose three causes sit in other files than the symptom, in a 20-file app
tasks.hard_because: Symptoms appear in batch output; the three causes are a mutated shared default in customer.js, a cache key in rates.js and an off-by-one comparison in dates.js. Single invoices on most dates and the visible tests are correct.

tasks.summary: Subscription billing dates to a written spec: month-end clamping, business-day roll, holidays, pauses
tasks.hard_because: Several rules interact (anchor day kept across short months, modified-following roll that can go backwards, holidays, pauses on the adjusted date, skipped dates not counted). The hidden check covers combinations the visible tests do not.

tasks.summary: Make a quadratic customer-dedupe job fast without changing its output
tasks.hard_because: The naive pairwise job is correct but cannot finish on 150k rows. A fast version needs indexing plus transitive grouping, and must keep the exact matching rules (empty values never match, gmail normalization, the name+zip rule).

tasks.summary: Add a --since date filter whose obvious reading (UTC midnight) contradicts the documented convention
tasks.hard_because: The instruction says entries have UTC timestamps; the README and the existing --until code say command-line dates are calendar days in the account time zone. An agent that does not read them filters on UTC midnight and fails at the day boundary.

tasks.summary: Deduplicate three exporters into a shared module while keeping byte-identical output
tasks.hard_because: The three copies look identical but differ in small ways (booleans, datetimes, decimals, sort order of strings, missing values). A refactor that unifies them breaks byte-for-byte output that the visible tests do not cover.

tasks.summary: Fix ordering and concurrency bugs in an async job queue that show only under load
tasks.hard_because: The visible test passes. The bugs (retry path double-releases a slot, drain resolves while jobs still run, results land in completion order, a sync throw escapes) appear only under a randomized stress check.

tasks.summary: Migrate messy v1 user records to the v2 schema: names, phones, mixed date formats with DST, duplicate merge, idempotency
tasks.hard_because: Many small rules from MIGRATION.md interact on real-world data: name particles, phone prefixes, three timestamp formats including Helsinki local time across DST, merging duplicates by email with a tie rule, and records already in v2 that must pass through.
